text: The initiative features VAT-exempt premiums, rapid digital payouts via mobile money, and explicit inclusion targets for women and persons with disabilities. It is supported by South–South cooperation with India and integrates with national policy objectives. The program uses parametric triggers for quick payouts, reducing delays and ambiguity, and includes outreach campaigns to increase literacy and uptake among vulnerable groups.

metadata.solution_name: Scaling Climate and Disaster Risk Financing Framework and Parametric Insurance in Fiji
